threshold: lowest exact >= boundary accepting at least .95 normals and .90 real updates; normal validation only
selection: all fits successful; mean change binary-class-macro F1 minus .5 sample SD; lower update FPR, overall FPR, complexity, id
test_scope: reused simulated benchmark, not external validation
architecture_scope: historically motivated architectures; no claim that mechanisms were unknown to researchers
mechanism_semantics: Type-i and Type-i-ta jointly fitted and selected; equal variant-weighted metrics, not post-hoc pooling
budget_semantics: N total attack source records per mechanism, unique across variants; finite budgets balanced within one; All covers union with imbalance reported
